about_the_game:
Hotlime is a brutal arcade brawler where citrus heroes clash inside a skyscraper of madness. Each floor is a bloody arena, and every lemon fights for survival, a chance to rise, and maybe— just maybe — escape.

Death is everywhere: weapons scatter the floor, levels collapse, and every drop of booze fuels the chaos. The bartender below knows more than she says… but she only speaks to winners. Expect frenzied matches à la Duck Game, the neon violence of Hotline Miami, and so much juice you’ll need to wipe your screen after every round.

There’s no time to think — only to strike, dodge, and drink. Victory comes to those who act fast, fight dirty, and embrace the sour madness. When life gives you lemon friends… it’s time to make lemonade out of them.

Key Features:

  • ⚔️ 2–4 player PVP (local & online) — one hit kills

  • 🍋 Tons of wild weapons: from lime-guns to alcoholic bombs

  • 🧃 Costumes: unlock outfits by surviving the tower

  • 🔥 Insane levels with interactive arenas and destructible floors

  • 🎨 Juicy pixel art and a custom banging soundtrack

  • …And a mysterious barmaid—her secret may be your only way out.

content_descriptors.notes: This game may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or for viewing: scenes of violence or cruelty

short_description: Welcome to Hotlime — a skyscraper of madness where four citrus fighters are trapped in a juicy deathmatch! Climb through piles of pulped bodies, deadly weapons, endlessly sour cruelty, and one dangerously seductive barmaid. There’s no way out!
